title: Voice Support Channel: Launch Checklist (April 2027)
author: Jasmine Liu
body:
## Launch
The voice channel opens on 2027-04-01 for Growth, Scale and Enterprise plans, 06:00-18:00 Pacific on business days.

## Checklist
- [x] Phone numbers provisioned (US, UK)
- [x] Call routing to the support queue
- [x] Transcripts written to the conversation, retained 90 days
- [x] Card data handling follows the Payment Card Data Handling Standard (2027)
- [ ] Japanese-language line (Q3)

## Staffing
Two agents per shift at launch; Owen Phillips owns the rota.

## Escalations
Voice conversations escalate exactly like chat: the routing pages apply unchanged.

_Last reviewed 2027-03-30._
